// diagnostic E0395

Jet.InvalidChannelCapacity

A channel capacity must be at least 1, not `{capacity}`.

What

A channel capacity must be at least 1, not `{capacity}`.

Why

A bounded channel holds at least one value; Jet has no zero-capacity rendezvous channel, and a capacity below 1 is never clamped. A runtime capacity below 1 stops the program (Jet.Panic).

Fix

Write `channel<T>(capacity: 1)` or larger, or `channel<T>()` for an unbounded channel.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.InvalidChannelCapacity: Tests/UI/channel_capacity_below_one.stderr.

 Fix: Write `channel<T>(capacity: 1)` or larger, or `channel<T>()` for an unbounded channel.
